paragraphs: Chapter 988
Episode 245. Kinzelo's Ingenious Strategy (1)

It has been twelve days since the Barmel Alliance obtained the Pivil's parts. However, both the Barmel Alliance and the Red Name Tribe have not released any articles regarding it, so people were still talking about the Zipl and the Red Name Tribe.
The Zipl have not yet begun their revenge against the Red Name Tribe.

Except for the single attack the Alliance launched on Bacl, the Red Name Tribe had not been attacked by any force. The Red Name Tribe appeared to have stabilized all their occupied territories and seemed to be catching their breath.
Over 80% of the continent that was Lutero Federation's land just ten days ago had now become the possession of the Red Name Tribe.
"Whew."
Philops sighed and put down the news report.
"Lord Philops?"
"Dad, what's wrong?"
Bubar and Ainas, who were nearby, looked at Philops.
"The other day, the commander said that these guys would surely try to deal with us first."
"The Red Name Tribe?"
"Us?"
"Yes."
The ultimate goals of the Red Name Tribe and Kinzelo were very similar.
To resurrect the Sun God. But the world they sought to create through the resurrection of the Sun God was entirely different.
Three forces that wanted the resurrection of the Sun God, namely Kinzelo, the Red Name Tribe, and the Sun God Church, all had these differences.
"We have the most information about the Sun God Kinzelo among the existing forces of favor. Plus, at present, our war capabilities are among the lowest."
"You mean we're lower than the failed Zipl!?"
"Bubar, Zipl hasn't failed. Only the uninformed general public thinks that."
"What, really?"
"They haven't failed!?"
Philops looked at the two, holding his forehead, suddenly feeling sympathetic for how much hardship Bishukel must have endured because of these two.

"The heart of Zipl is the Tower of Story. Although they lost many fleets and forces, they will recover quickly as long as they have the magic stones and holy land. Moreover, all key figures above the superhuman level are intact. Therefore, crushing us first would be better for the Red Name Tribe's perspective, rather than finishing them off."
"Not only that, Jipl is also a means for the Jeokmyeong tribe to check the Bamel Alliance..."
"Has Vishukel arrived?"
"Vishukel's here?"
Vishukel was looking even more downcast than usual.

As the deputy commander, he knew better than anyone the critical crisis that Kinjelo is currently facing. Kinjelo was already recuperating after subduing the Zito, and he never expected the Jeokmyeong tribe to rise like this.
"Is Marjiella okay?"
"...It's the same. Just when she seems stable, she shows signs of going berserk, and Jephirin has to barely calm her down."
As he brushed his hair back, dozens of strands clung to Vishukel's palm. Pirobs looked at him with sympathetic eyes.
"It must be because of the weight of the great mission that fell on her. You must be having a hard time."
"The situation is really not good, Mr. Pirobs. The Commander is trying to make contact with Ganesto, but they don't seem to be interested in meeting."
Even if they meet Ganesto, there's no guarantee of success. It's just a desperate attempt at making a deal.
"Then the only remaining negotiation target is Jipl... Negotiating with the Bamel Alliance using the left arm of Temar Lunkandel, since the royal family has been destroyed, would be wrong."
"However, the chances of negotiations with Jipl are also not high. The fact that they, having lost Drakka, did not reach out to us first means they have read the situation accurately."
"Then we must initiate contact first, and propose something attractive enough that they have no reason to refuse."

"If they join hands with us, we can certainly hurt either the Jeokmyeong tribe or the Bamel Alliance, or help in completing the Masin Stone. The former is more than enough for us, but the latter could be a bigger problem after temporary cooperation with Jipl ends."
"The latter is possible by just deploying this Bubar here. Surprisingly so... But as you said, that solution is only temporary. Hmm, a way to hurt both the Jeokmyeong tribe and the Bamel Alliance."
It was a dream-like conversation.

The Bamel Alliance and the Jeokmyeong tribe naturally had no intention of attacking each other right now. That's why Simat returned Luna and Eltiot without killing them, and Jin didn't initiate a full-scale war even after Luna returned injured.
"The Commander said that Jeokmyeong tribe's power is clearly the strongest right now. If the Bamel Alliance and Jeokmyeong tribe go to full-scale war now, the Jeokmyeong tribe will definitely win."
"Even though the Bamel Alliance's strength has risen that much...?"
"Yes, not even a very narrow victory. The difference in fleet strength, including aerial fortresses, is just too great."
"What's most regrettable is that we don't have time. If Marjiella could just control that power, we wouldn't be so desperate."
When speaking of Marjiella, Pirobs cautiously watched Vishukel's expression. Vishukel didn't show any sign of displeasure, but it couldn't have been pleasant to hear.
The two people soon sighed repeatedly.
"Dad, what if I read the thoughts of the Jeokmyeong tribe properly with my dream ability?"
"There's no need to risk examining the Jeokmyeong tribe right now. It's obvious what they will do."
"What about reading the dreams of the Barmel Alliance?"

"That's also dangerous. They must be aware of our dream ability. We could end up hitting not only the Jeokmyeong tribe but also the Barmel Alliance. If that happens, it will truly be the end for us. We won't even have a chance to escape."
"Wow, we've become the talk of the town. So what about just running away?"

"It's possible, but we can't do it because of our great task. If we give up everything and hide, the Jeokmyeong tribe will surely resurrect the Sun God before us. It's better to try something and face destruction."
At that moment, suddenly coming up with an idea, Bubar swung the sweet potato croquette like a knife. The crumbs flew into the faces of Bishukel and Pirobs, and Pirobs almost exploded with rage.
"Uh, Mr. Pirobs, and Officer Bishukel! I've thought of a good idea."
"I don't have high expectations, but say it. That's what your mouth is for."
"The Commander once said he wanted to use the Myeongwang tribe in Laprarosa, remember?"
"Yes, he did."
"So we found out what we think is the entrance to Laprarosa. Kelkel."
"...Mitra Desert?"
Bishukel asked, wiping the sweat from his brow.
"Yes! The Mitra Desert. What if we use it?"

"So Bubar, you mean to leak that information to the Jeokmyeong tribe? That Jin Runakandel will extract the Myeongwang tribe from the Mitra Desert? Then the Jeokmyeong tribe would naturally restrain the Barmel Alliance from becoming stronger instead of us?"
At Bishukel's reply, Bubar frowned in disappointment.
"Our Officer Bishukel, you seemed wise, but how did you..."
Bishukel, boiling with anger to the tips of his hair, managed to hold back and waited for his next words.
"They won't bite that bait so easily, will they? Do you think they'll believe what we say so easily?"
"You're right, Bishukel was really foolish just now."
"...So what do you want to do, Bubar?"
"We'll pretend there's something great in the Mitra Desert, and show them we're obsessed with it!"
"What did you say?"

"Actually, half of it is true. In the past, Lanke tried to summon the old archdukes of the demon world from there. However, he got beaten by Jin Run-kandel and ended up failing. In any case, doing so will make the Jeokmyeokjok curious about what we're doing in that desert wasteland, and the Barmel Union will be annoyed with us."
"Ah, Bubar."
"It sounds like a perfect act to get both forces to kill us."
At Pirob's reply, Bishukel lowered his head, looking quite shocked.
"No, Mr. Pirob... Although it's frustrating, it's not without reason."
"Are you serious, Bishukel?"
"Yes. If we follow Bubar's plan, we can naturally gather the Jeokmyeokjok and the Barmel Union in the Mitra Desert. This could naturally lead to tension between the two, possibly leading to battle."
"If Laphralosa is indeed hidden in the Mitra Desert, Jin Run-kandel can't just ignore it. Especially if the Jeokmyeokjok gets a hint about Laphralosa."
"Bishukel is smart again!"
"Let's just say it's all thanks to Bubar guiding Mr. Bishukel."
Even as Ainas and Bubar laughed and clapped, Bishukel wasn't angry. He felt like an unexpected solution had appeared.
"In this process, the Jeokmyeokjok will definitely find out that Jin Run-kandel is obsessed with the Mitra Desert. Thus, they'll have to invest a significant force there."
"If we're lucky, the Jeokmyeokjok and the Barmel Union might engage in full combat in the Mitra Desert...?"

"Yes, Mr. Pirob. It's a very risky venture, but if successful, we can buy the most essential thing for us: time. Additionally, we can hope that both the Barmel Union and the Jeokmyeokjok will weaken simultaneously."
Pirob pondered for a moment.
"This isn't something just you and I can decide. It's better to ask the leader when he returns tonight."
"Let's do that, Mr. Pirob."
When night fell, Orgal, who returned to the divine headquarters, nodded after hearing Bubar's plan, looking refreshed.

"Let's do that. It's undoubtedly a risky move, but we have no other viable options. From what I've heard, it's almost a guaranteed success. Jin Run-kandel is obsessed with Laphralosa's siblings, and the Jeokmyeokjok is most wary of him."
"I don't understand why I overlooked this strategy. That such a disgusting rat like Bubar thought of it... When should we start?"
"As soon as the Jeokmyeokjok makes a move against us, it'll be too late. We need to start right now."

Members of the Kinsel group looked at Bubar with pride for the first time in a while. Bubar, in a corner of the conference room, was playing rock-paper-scissors with Ainas and didn't notice their looks.
